Vì sao SeeVia ưu tiên đọc văn bản tiếng: Why is SeeVia prioritising Vietnamese text reading?
Bản mẫu đầu tiên tập trung vào đọc chữ,: The first prototype focuses on reading text, recognising objects and everyday information before moving into more complex tasks.
Một trang tài liệu, nhãn sản phẩm hay bả: A document, product label or notice contains information needed for study and work. SeeVia starts with these specific situations: helping users access print and visual information through speech, rather than switching between tools or asking someone else to read.
Trong phạm vi bản mẫu đầu tiên, nhóm ưu: For the first prototype, the team prioritises reading text and documents, recognising objects and answering questions about images. Vietnamese diacritics, Vietnamese money and familiar objects need direct testing, beyond simply checking whether the system can respond in Vietnamese.
Nhóm dự kiến ưu tiên thử nghiệm với ngườ: The team plans to prioritise trials with young low-vision people who are studying or working and already use smartphones or assistive technology. Blind pupils and students at schools and centres form an additional group. This initial choice needs validation, with each group's results considered separately.
Việc thu hẹp phạm vi giúp nhóm tập trung: A narrower scope lets the team measure accuracy, assistance required and task completion. Independent navigation and travel-safety tasks are not assured prototype capabilities. SeeVia aims to provide additional information, not replace a white cane or orientation skills.
Một nút bấm, một yêu cầu: cách tương tác: One button, one request: the interaction SeeVia is working towards
Nhấn nút, nói điều cần biết và nghe phản: Press the button, say what you need and hear a response. The flow is designed to reduce reliance on screens while keeping the wearer in control.
Với SeeVia, người dùng không cần bắt đầu: With SeeVia, users do not need to start by finding an icon on a screen. The core flow in the project documents is: press a button, speak a request, let the system process it and receive an audio response. The camera, microphone and control button all support this flow.
Ví dụ, khi muốn đọc một tờ thông báo, ng: To read a notice, for example, the wearer points the glasses towards it, presses the button and makes a request. The image feeds the recognition and analysis stages, and the result is read aloud. This describes the intended prototype interaction, not a guarantee of speed or accuracy in every situation.
Camera được định hướng chỉ ghi nhận khi: The camera is intended to capture images on request rather than record continuously. The team also needs to test how the device signals that a request was received, that processing is underway and that a task has finished. A correct answer is not enough if the wearer does not know what the device is doing.
Bên cạnh thao tác, cách xử lý, lưu trữ v: Alongside interaction design, data processing, storage and deletion need to be explained before user trials. The aim is to reduce the steps users must remember while helping them understand and control each interaction with the glasses.
SeeVia dự kiến kiểm chứng bản mẫu như th: How does SeeVia plan to validate the prototype?
Đánh giá từ việc người dùng có hoàn thàn: Assess whether users complete tasks, how much assistance they need and whether they keep using the device, rather than only asking whether they like it.
Một bản trình diễn chạy được chưa cho bi: A working demonstration does not establish usefulness in daily life. The project documents pose three questions: do users actually face this difficulty, does SeeVia make the task easier, and do they want to keep using it?
Trước khi đưa kính vào một tình huống th: Before a trial, the team plans to understand how participants currently read documents, recognise objects and access information. Their existing methods provide a baseline to identify where the device helps and whether it introduces inconvenient extra steps.
Khi thử bản mẫu, các chỉ số cần theo dõi: Prototype trials should track task completion, time taken, recognition errors, requests for help and ease of use. Whether participants continue using the device after getting familiar with it matters more than a positive comment immediately after a demonstration.
Đây là kế hoạch kiểm chứng, không phải b: This is a validation plan, not a report of results. Trial conditions, participant consent and data handling must be confirmed before implementation. Feedback will guide changes to features, experience and prototype scope before expansion.
